results.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
results.original_title: 名探偵コナン 30号殺人事件
results.overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

results.title: Instant
results.overview: Two stories intertwine at the moment life changes forever. Between diagnoses, farewells, therapy sessions and new opportunities, four people discover that love doesn't always come when we expect it… but it always comes when we need it.

results.title: Love At Last
results.overview: The funny story of Aslı, an advertising executive who doesn't want to be alone on Valentine's Day.

results.title: Allegedly
results.overview: After participating in an anonymous survey at the request of a mentor, a high school graduate begins to uncover the predatory reality of their relationship.

results.title: Welcome To The Jungle
results.overview: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

results.title: No Mercy
results.overview: From the starting point of her admiration for the pioneering Ukrainian filmmaker Kira Muratova (1934-2018), the director poses a question: is cinema made by women really tougher, more violent? Seeking answers, she talks to great contemporary filmmakers like Catherine Breillat, Virginie Despentes, Alice Diop, Céline Sciamma, Ana Lily Amirpour, and Monika Treut, among others. It becomes obvious that the cinema screen is a space for the projection of real social problems and power relations.

results.title: O Little Christmas Market
results.overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

results.title: The Swedish Connection
results.overview: Swedish Foreign Ministry bureaucrat Gösta Engzell, overlooked during WWII, rescued thousands while turning supposedly neutral Sweden into a moral force. His efforts challenged the status quo and left a lasting humanitarian legacy.

results.title: Vibe
results.overview: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

results.title: The Old Dog
results.overview: A homicide, a massive outstanding debt, a short-selling scheme - it all stems from a seemingly unremarkable yet highly suspicious theft. Jing Youzheng, a police officer nearing retirement, senses something amiss; as the investigation deepens, every clue points toward Bian Juhan, Chairman of the Mingdian Group. The veteran officer relentlessly pursues the case and takes the offensive, while Chairman Bian launches a counterattack. What is the actual truth? Amidst this clash between good and evil, what kind of high-stakes drama will unfold between these two adversaries?

results.title: Taste
results.overview: coming soon

results.title: Winter Wonderlanes
results.overview: Audrey Bell  is a globe-trotting pop-up restaurateur who returns home for Thanksgiving to the news that her late grandfather’s beloved bowling alley, Wonderlanes, will be sold. Audrey agrees to stay for one last festive season at Wonderlanes and decides to revive its iconic Winter Wonderlanes youth bowling tournament. To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind. As the tournament draws near, Audrey questions her next move that will take her away from the people and places she loves…and decide if she’s ready to walk away from Wonderlanes – or finally put down roots where her heart truly belongs.

results.title: Le Roi du Game
results.overview: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

results.title: Bhai Tera Star Hai
results.overview: An actor's cricket gambling debt puts him on a deadly deadline. His lie about his sister sets off a catastrophic evening of confused criminals, botched crimes, and pandemonium racing across London.

results.title: ¿Querés ser mi hijo?
results.overview: Lucía, a 42-year-old woman, discovers her partner's infidelity after a 15-year relationship and must reorganize her personal and professional life. She asks her young neighbor to pretend to be her son for a job opportunity.

results.title: Kiloran Bay
results.overview: Kiloran Bay is written and directed by Michael Bruce: A musical short film starring Alan Cumming and Jack Wolfe. After decades away, a gay man returns home to Scotland to attend a traditional wedding and faces a past he spent a lifetime avoiding.

results.title: Old Bandits
results.overview: An elderly retired couple teams up with young partners to plan a daring bank robbery, while trying to outwit a detective determined to stop them.

results.title: The Loved One
results.overview: Ten years later, former lovers Ellie and Eric meet again to trace the memories of a love and sorrow that never went away.

results.title: Maid's Obsession
results.overview: Martha, a longtime helper, fears losing her job when a new maid arrives. Rivalry turns to closeness as secrets and desire blur boundaries, forcing both to choose between security and temptation.

results.title: Sciatunostro
results.overview: Two children, Ettore and Giovannino, grow up together on a Mediterranean island. At the end of the summer, Ettore is forced to move to the mainland to continue his studies, leaving a void on the island that Giovannino must fill. In a seemingly endless winter, the archive and video camera of Pino, an elderly amateur videographer, come to his aid.
